python3 << 'EOF'
# 1970 data from treasury_bulletin_1970_03_page_88.txt
# Regular weekly and annual maturing Treasury bills (second column = Total amount outstanding)
regular_1970 = [1501, 13510, 13516, 16525, 6308, 6512, 7721, 1701, 1505, 1003, 1001, 1002]
tax_ant_1970 = [1752, 3014, 4508]

# 1975 data from treasury_bulletin_1975_03_page_71.txt
# Regular weekly and annual maturing (Feb 1975 through Jan 1976)
regular_1975 = [20916, 20031, 20328, 14812, 13517, 14819, 1803, 1803, 2003, 2002, 2001, 2001]
tax_ant_1975 = [2251, 1256]

total_regular_1970 = sum(regular_1970)
total_tax_ant_1970 = sum(tax_ant_1970)
total_regular_1975 = sum(regular_1975)
total_tax_ant_1975 = sum(tax_ant_1975)

print(f"1970 - Regular weekly & annual maturing: {total_regular_1970}")
print(f"1970 - Tax anticipation: {total_tax_ant_1970}")
print(f"1970 - Total: {total_regular_1970 + total_tax_ant_1970}")
print()
print(f"1975 - Regular weekly & annual maturing: {total_regular_1975}")
print(f"1975 - Tax anticipation: {total_tax_ant_1975}")
print(f"1975 - Total: {total_regular_1975 + total_tax_ant_1975}")
print()

# Absolute changes (1975 - 1970)
abs_change_regular = total_regular_1975 - total_regular_1970
abs_change_tax_ant = total_tax_ant_1975 - total_tax_ant_1970

print(f"Absolute change - Regular: {abs_change_regular}")
print(f"Absolute change - Tax anticipation: {abs_change_tax_ant}")
print()

# Euclidean norm
import math
euclidean_norm = math.sqrt(abs_change_regular**2 + abs_change_tax_ant**2)
print(f"Euclidean norm: {euclidean_norm}")
print(f"Euclidean norm (rounded to nearest hundredths): {round(euclidean_norm, 2)}")
EOF
